$comment: Scene metadata for the narrated tutorial: what each narration line teaches and shows. build.mjs combines it with script.json and the measured audio into storyboard.md; beats.mjs turns it into exact animation times. 'section' entries set the step caption beside the app window from that line on.

intro.1.goal: Know what this video teaches and the app's name
intro.1.focus: AMWAG logo draws, then the app name

intro.2.goal: Understand the four things the app does by itself
intro.2.focus: Four step chips appear as each job is spoken: find printer, driver, ticket size, verify

intro.3.goal: Feel that the employee's part is small

open.1.goal: Start the app from the folder IT provides
open.1.focus: File window of the distribution folder; AMWAG Printer Setup.exe
open.1.cursor: glides to the exe, double-clicks on 'دبل كليك'

open.2.zoom: splash zooms into the app window

steps.0.goal: Know the language follows Windows and can be switched

steps.1.goal: Read progress from the six-step list

steps.2.goal: Know USB and network printers are both found
steps.2.focus: Detecting printer ticks; printer card fills row by row

steps.3.goal: Understand the driver is checked and installed only if needed
steps.3.focus: Checking driver ticks; Installing driver with integrity check text

steps.5.goal: Do not close the window during setup
steps.5.focus: Window close button marked with a warning

uac.1.goal: Recognise the app's warning before Windows asks

uac.2.goal: Choose Yes in the Windows permission prompt

uac.3.goal: Know the prompt appears once, and only when needed

ready.1.goal: Understand the ticket defaults the app sets
ready.1.focus: Driver installed ticks; Configuring ticket size; ticket size row highlighted; four defaults listed

ready.2.goal: Know the app double-checks its work

ready.3.goal: Recognise success: six green steps and 'Ready to print tickets'
ready.3.focus: Ready ticks; result screen with green check

test.1.cursor: moves to the button, clicks after its name

test.2.goal: Load ticket paper in the multipurpose tray and print

test.3.focus: Sending, then Printing; ticket feeds out beside the window

test.4.focus: Corner marks light up on the ticket; first check ticks

test.5.focus: Bars light up; second check ticks

test.6.goal: Check text is upright, nothing cut off, and the tray
test.6.focus: TOP arrow and ticket edge light up; checks three and four tick

soft.1.goal: Start the optional ticket software check
soft.1.focus: Check ticket software link, then waiting for a print job

soft.2.goal: Understand the check only reads and compares
soft.2.focus: Result banner and comparison table rows

soft.3.goal: Know what to do with a difference

cases.1.goal: Enter the 'situations you may meet' part
cases.1.focus: Section caption; window resets to detection

cases.2.goal: Choose the ticket printer when several are found
cases.2.focus: Choose the ticket printer screen with two printers
cases.2.cursor: selects the USB ticket printer, clicks Continue
cases.2.zoom: spotlight on the cards, then Continue

cases.3.cursor: clicks the field, types the address, clicks Find printer

cases.4.goal: Confirm the model only if the label matches
cases.4.focus: Is this the right printer? screen beside a printer label

cases.5.focus: Permission was not given result; Try again

cases.6.focus: Windows prompt asking for an administrator user name and password

fix.1.goal: Report a bad test ticket and follow the guidance
fix.1.focus: There is a problem, then the guidance list

fix.2.goal: Read printer problems during the test print
fix.2.focus: Printer reported a problem: out of paper

fix.3.goal: Use Repair or Try again when not ready
fix.3.focus: The printer is not ready result; Repair

outro.1.focus: Recap list builds item by item

outro.2.focus: AMWAG IT Department line; silent on-screen developer credit
